::: {#def-model-card}

#### Model card

A **model card** is a short document released with a trained model
that reports its intended uses and its performance,
including [disaggregated evaluation](#def-disaggregated-evaluation)s over the groups that matter for those uses [@mitchell2019model].
@mitchell2019model [section 4] suggest nine sections:

- model details;
- intended use;
- factors, the groups or conditions the performance may depend on;
- metrics;
- evaluation data;
- training data; <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
- quantitative analyses;
- ethical considerations;
- caveats and recommendations.

:::
